answer_example.question: I need a memory system for my agent: Python, MIT licence, runs locally. Which fits, and is anything faster or cheaper?
answer_example.text:
Memory systems for an agent (Python, MIT licence, runs locally), from the memory-systems feed: scan 20261031T2327Z at 2026-10-31T23:30:18Z, 587 repositories gathered, answered from stored nouns with no model call.
1. semantica-agi/semantica (https://github.com/semantica-agi/semantica): 14358 stars, last commit 2026-10-31, MIT, Python, local+hosted. LongMemEval, LoCoMo, latency, cost: not reported.
2. tigerless-labs/agent-memory (https://github.com/tigerless-labs/agent-memory): 4303 stars, last commit 2026-10-30, MIT, Python, local. LongMemEval, LoCoMo, latency, cost: not reported.
3. OSU-NLP-Group/HippoRAG (https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/HippoRAG): 4085 stars, last commit 2026-10-06, MIT, Python, local+hosted. LongMemEval, LoCoMo, latency, cost: not reported.
4. aiming-lab/SimpleMem (https://github.com/aiming-lab/SimpleMem): 3858 stars, last commit 2026-07-24, MIT, Python, local. LongMemEval, LoCoMo, latency, cost: not reported.
5. ClaudioDrews/memory-os (https://github.com/ClaudioDrews/memory-os): 1384 stars, last commit 2026-09-20, MIT, Python, local. LongMemEval, LoCoMo, latency, cost: not reported.
Faster or cheaper? Reported speed or cost: xerj-org/xerj (Rust, Apache-2.0, local) cost "XERJ | 9,982 | $1.58 |"; MemTensor/MemOS (TypeScript, Apache-2.0, local+hosted) cost "72% lower token usage and multi-agent memory sharing"; supermemoryai/supermemory (TypeScript, MIT, local) latency "One call. ~50ms.".
None of the picks above reports latency or cost.
Numbers are the projects' own claims, quoted verbatim from their READMEs or papers and checked character by character; nobody here re-ran them. Ranked by quoted evidence, then stars, then recency.
